import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_21/test_0.csv"
    ]

    # List to hold dataframes from all sources
    dfs = []

    # Load each source file, select relevant columns, and append to dfs
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
        # Select only the columns needed for the target: Major_category and Median
        # Median might have nulls, so we keep them for aggregation
        df_subset = df[['Major_category', 'Median']].copy()
        dfs.append(df_subset)

    # Concatenate all source dataframes vertically
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Group by Major_category and calculate average Median (ignoring nulls)
    result_df = combined_df.groupby('Major_category', as_index=False)['Median'].mean()

    # Ensure the Median column is float type
    result_df['Median'] = result_df['Median'].astype(float)

    # Write the result to the target CSV file
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_21/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    result_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
